api.notKDFieldMeaning: These three are depth/SILog/depth-gradient settings, not distillation knobs.

mechanism.teacher: Frozen eval/no_grad; teacher sees entire batch in stock implementation.
mechanism.features: Detect input neck levels plus head hook; YOLO11 uses16/19/22/23 with P3/P4/P5 strides8/16/32.
mechanism.projectors: Two1x1conv layers with ReLU, randomly initialized, map student channels to teacher channels.
mechanism.loss: Per-level L2 feature difference weighted by max teacher sigmoid class confidence; divide by teacher score sum times channels, then multiply dis and batch size.

differencesFromOurOutputKD: Our retention terms explicitly separate teacher-positive>=0.1 and teacher-background<0.05 top256 anchors; their means are equally weighted. BoxDFL KL uses teacher confidence>=0.25. All KD is restricted to old_anchor train rows.
Stock official KD uses neck features, not class/DFL output KL. The project currently has no intermediate P3 feature preservation.

Our masks are teacher-confidence masks, not GT foreground masks: a true small GT with weak teacher confidence can receive no positive/box KD. This is a plausible vulnerability, not an established explanation of all47 extra small FN.
Stock teacher-score normalization is per feature level; low absolute confidence does not turn off an entire low-confidence/empty level because weights are normalized by their sum.
Stock whole-batch KD could constrain new hardcase and true-empty images toward the old teacher, including its glare false positive. Keep source gating when adapting featureKD.

Identical teacher/student weights still had synthetic dis_loss7.4969 due to random projectors. For same-architecture retention, test identity/direct normalized feature loss rather than assume the stock compression objective starts at zero.

repositories.role: Separate sliced-training preparation from sliced inference/postprocessing.
sourceFacts: slice_coco exports a COCO sliced dataset; slice_image/process_coco_annotations clip annotations and retain by min_area_ratio(default0.1). It does not itself train a detector.
ignore_negative_samples defaultsFalse. Retaining actual negative crops is relevant to the empty-glare failure; examples that drop negatives would be inappropriate here.

get_sliced_prediction defaults full-image prediction enabled,20%tile overlap, GREEDYNMM, IOS0.5, class-aware. It shifts/collects all tile outputs then merges; there is no original-quadrant-center rejection rule.

At low model confidence, current implementation automatically switches merging to NMS/IOU unless force_postprocess_type=True. Our AP caches use confidence0.001, so defaults must not be described as actual NMM behavior without checking this branch.
differenceFromCurrent: Current4tile uses60%image extents at0/40%positions, equivalent33.3%tile overlap rather than SAHI default20%; same1024crop inference magnifies objects1.667×.

Current training is whole-frame plus ordinary scale/translation augmentation, and current deployed inference applies quadrant ownership before finalNMS0.7 with no full-frame pass. This is an engineering pipeline, not complete SAHI sliced fine-tuning or standard SAHI inference.

Truncated large objects can be duplicated or mislabeled across slices. Freeze partial-object policy, keep source/session groups intact, do not count4crops as4independent plates or inflate their sampling mass.
NMM/IoS can merge two genuinely touching colonies. More slicing/merging is not guaranteed better counting.

repositories.role: Borrow explicit detection-distillation loss definitions and layer mapping, not replace the entire environment first.

sourceFacts.CWD: ChannelWiseDivergence normalizes spatial positions per channel with temperature softmax and averagesKL over N*C; suitable source for per-level preservation.
sourceFacts.PKD: PKDLoss normalizes each channel over batch/spatial values to zero mean/unitstd, thenMSE/2; designed to reduce scale/magnitude mismatch.
sourceFacts.MGD: MGDConnector masks spatial features and reconstructs through a generator; MGDLoss sumsMSE/N. Random spatial masking is not GT-small-object balancing.
sourceFacts.FBKD: FBKD uses spatial/channel attention and feature/relation terms; code averages teacher/student spatial masks. This is not a GT foreground/background size mask; no claim FGD is provided in the inspected official tree.
sourceFacts.framework: ConfigurableDistiller recorders/connectors/data_idx explicitly map student/teacher features; SingleTeacherDistill controls teacher trainability/BN eval.
